text:
Alex Chen: Quick flag bug: API ref for POST /v1/generate shows include_metadata quoted in the curl example (e.g. ?include_metadata=\"true\") which ends up being parsed as a string and can cause 400s in some SDK flows.

Marta Lf3pez: Oof. Can you paste the exact curl snippet you saw?

Alex Chen: Here it is:
```
curl -X POST \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?include_metadata=\"true\"' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","prompt":"hi"}'
```
Server expects boolean or omission. Should be either `?include_metadata=true` or include_metadata in the JSON body as a boolean.

Rick Patel: I can open a docs PR to change the curl and the Node fetch snippet. Will scan Ruby/Go examples too.

Maya Singh: Also recommend adding a short migration note under the param: "Avoid quoted booleans in querystring; prefer body boolean or unquoted flag."

Alex Chen: Proposed edits:
- Update curl to `?include_metadata=true`
- Update Node fetch example to put include_metadata: true in body
- Add a one-line migration/copy note under the param

Marta Lf3pez: Sounds good. Rick, drop Marta on the PR for copy review.

Rick Patel: PR drafted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1291 title: "docs(generate): fix include_metadata examples and add migration note". I updated curl, JS snippet, and added the param note. Kept Ruby/Go SDK examples unchanged but added a comment that SDKs should pass booleans in param objects.

Marta Lf3pez: Small copy nit: replace "legacy clients" with "older clients" and format the quoted example in monospace. Also add a short callout in the endpoint overview: "Boolean query flags must be unquoted" so it's easier to spot.

Rick Patel: Updated per nit. Also adjusted docs CI to run the curl example with `--silent --fail` to catch non-2xx returns. I ran the curl against staging and got 200.

Maya Singh: From API side LGTM. We should avoid changing server to accept quoted strings; that'll mask contract violations. But let's schedule telemetry to surface incoming quoted booleans so we can measure impact.

docs-bot: PR merged by marta-lopez: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ab12cd34 Message: "merge: fix include_metadata examples and note"

deploy-bot: staging deploy started: docs-site/docs@staging build #8502

Marta Lf3pez: Deployed to staging. Doing a quick smoke: tested curl + Node snippet both return 200 and sample response.

Alex Chen: Great. Filing ENG ticket to add telemetry for quoted boolean query params (ENG-1123). Will follow up to see if we should add a longer migration guide later.

Rick Patel: Closing thread after main merge. Thanks all! :tada:
